![How to Prevent Crow's Feet - The Dermatology Specialists](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/10090947-1509-0139-0000-f36e5468fbb4:4)
Crow’s feet are `fine lines and wrinkles that fan out from the outer corners of the eyes` . They are a normal part of aging and facial expression.[[1]](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/diseases/24586-crows-feet)[[2]](https://thedermgrouppartners.com/what-are-crows-feet-and-how-to-fix-them/)[[3]](https://www.westlakedermatology.com/blog/crows-feet-treatment-options/)[[4]](https://www.bioderma.us/en/expert-advice/sensitive-skin/crows-feet.html)[[5]](https://www.healthline.com/health/beauty-skin-care/crows-feet)

### What Causes Crow's Feet

- **Facial expressions:** Smiling, laughing, and squinting contract the orbicularis oculi muscle around the eye.[[1]](https://www.bioderma.us/en/expert-advice/sensitive-skin/crows-feet.html)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RnQdgcLU4Hc&t=20)
- **Natural aging:** The skin loses collagen and elastin over time, turning temporary (dynamic) lines into permanent (static) wrinkles.[[1]](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/diseases/24586-crows-feet)[[2]](https://www.bioderma.us/en/expert-advice/sensitive-skin/crows-feet.html)
- **Sun exposure:** Ultraviolet (UV) rays speed up the breakdown of skin fibers and lead to premature wrinkling.[[1]](https://www.bioderma.us/en/expert-advice/sensitive-skin/crows-feet.html)
- **Lifestyle factors:** Smoking, chronic stress, and lack of hydration weaken skin structure.[[1]](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/articles/crows-feet)[[2]](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/diseases/24586-crows-feet)[[3]](https://int.eucerin.com/skin-concerns/ageing-skin/crows-feet)

### Prevention

- **Sun protection:** Wear broad-spectrum sunscreen (SPF 30 or higher) and polarized sunglasses daily to stop UV damage and squinting.[[1]](https://www.healthline.com/health/beauty-skin-care/crows-feet)[[2]](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/diseases/24586-crows-feet)
- **Skincare routine:** Use gentle daily moisturizers and eye creams containing ingredients like retinol, peptides, or hyaluronic acid.[[1]](https://www.healthline.com/health/beauty-skin-care/crows-feet)[[2]](https://www.bioderma.us/en/expert-advice/sensitive-skin/crows-feet.html)
- **Healthy habits:** Avoid smoking, stay hydrated, and eat a nutrient-rich diet.[[1]](https://www.healthline.com/health/beauty-skin-care/crows-feet)[[2]](https://www.bioderma.us/en/expert-advice/sensitive-skin/crows-feet.html)

### Treatment Options

- **Topical products:** Over-the-counter or prescription retinoids (like retinol or tretinoin) and peptide creams help boost collagen.
- **Neuromodulators:** Injections like Botox, Dysport, or Xeomin relax the eye muscles to smooth dynamic lines.
- **In-office procedures:** Chemical peels, laser skin resurfacing, and dermal fillers target deeper static wrinkles and stimulate new tissue growth.
- **Makeup tips:** Use hydrating eye creams, lightweight foundations, and silicone-based primers instead of heavy powders that settle into lines.[[1]](https://thedermgrouppartners.com/what-are-crows-feet-and-how-to-fix-them/)[[2]](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/diseases/24586-crows-feet)[[3]](https://www.healthline.com/health/beauty-skin-care/crows-feet)[[4]](https://www.bioderma.us/en/expert-advice/sensitive-skin/crows-feet.html)[[5]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RnQdgcLU4Hc&t=20)[[6]](https://elemis.com/us/blog/how-to-get-rid-of-crows-feet)
